# ReeferDude — full context

ReeferDude is a flagship hemp brand founded by Ray Meadows and Jessica Mullins, built for learning, community, and the future. Hemp-derived products only. No actual cannabis is sold. 18+ only.

Membership tiers displayed on the site: Seed Starter $19/mo, Master Grower $49/mo, Ganjapreneur $99/mo. Checkout is not live; no page takes payment.

## ReeferDude — Let AI Grow It, You Smoke It | AI Budtender, Strain Lab, Grow Blueprints
https://reeferdude.com/
ReeferDude is the AI budtender flagship at reeferdude.com: a cannabis-infused chat where a floating avatar's smoke forms the menu — strain matching, a 3D print-on-demand Design Studio, grow-room blueprinting, a ghost marketplace, delivery and consultations. The store engine lives at potgrowhub.store. Let AI Grow It, You Smoke It.
